message: Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times.
text:
The Notes Improver is already confirmed (change c8.0), so your message changed nothing. It runs for the first time at 00:00 on the host clock tomorrow.

Two parts of your expectation are still open:

- **Notes files rise:** this is declared, but it can't be judged yet. The `notes_files.count` instrument is still a draft and expires 2026-11-02 at about 10:16 UTC, and the stock has no series. Shall I keep the instrument and link it to the stock?
- **Commit rate up 1.2x:** I can't declare this without knowing which flow you mean. The design has no commit-rate flow. Do you mean the rate of notes commits, or the rate of tickets reaching DONE?

Also still waiting on your choice: the Notes Improver emits `work.proposed`, which nothing listens to. I recommend making the Coordinator the listener, so its ideas become work. The alternative is to drop the emit, so its ideas only come to you.
